description: This file defines a PHP class 'Reward' within the OpenCart framework, specifically as an admin controller for handling API requests related to reward points tied to orders. It loads language resources, retrieves order reward totals based on an order ID passed via GET request, extracts reward point values from order totals, and renders a view with the reward data and user token.

classes.name: Reward
classes.description: Controller class handling API reward point retrieval for the admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method that processes the request to obtain reward points associated with an order ID, and returns the corresponding view.
